method: professional-tileset (ADR-010 method switch: licensed pixel art, not procedural code-drawn tiles as in forest-v3/v4/v4.1)
source: Ninja Adventure Asset Pack (pixel-boy, CC0), github.com/pixel-boy/NinjaAdventure, content/map/tileset_floor.png

resolutionDecision.chosen: 16px source art, nearest-neighbor 2x -> 32px engine tile (no 32px-native redraw)
resolutionDecision.reason: NinjaAdventure ships 16px tiles. Doubling to 32px keeps every pixel a crisp 2x2 block (no blur, no interpolation) and matches the engine's existing tileSize=32 grid and the DS creature/tamer sprite scale already locked by DIGIMON_SIZE_TABLE.md (tamer=26px reference) -- same conclusion as forest-v4's 'no architecture change before the visual proof' constraint (ADR-010), but now the 32px cell is reached by clean integer upscale of real licensed art instead of hand-drawing natively at 32px. Checked against evidence/idledex-canonical/canonical_founder_screenshot_night_forest.png: that reference's tile/character scale (treetop clusters relative to tamer height) sits in the same order of magnitude as 32px tiles with 2x-scaled 16px props, so no further rescale was needed.

canopySimplification: v5 canopy clumps are a single decor+collision tile (no base/top split like forest-v4). The licensed blob art has no separate trunk sprite, and the canonical IdleDex reference itself reads as massed canopy without individually readable trunks at this zoom -- see README self-critique #1.

autotile.pattern: 16-tile blob (same N/E/S/W bitmask + quarter-circle rounded-corner geometry as forest-v4's buildBlobTile, reused verbatim from art/src/forest_v4_tiles.js via art/src/na_blob.js), but the foreground/background fills are tiled crops of real licensed pixel art (art/src/na_source.js tiledFill) instead of procedurally painted textures.

groundStamps.note: Multi-tile decals cropped verbatim from the artist's own pre-composed blob shapes (not reconstructed tile-by-tile), so the hand-painted transition shading is reused exactly as drawn -- place as a single large decal on the ground layer, not tiled.

props.note: hue-shifted from the licensed blossom-canopy blob (orange->green, +0.25 turn), satMul 0.9
